title: Does a Leader Who Gives No Press Conferences Avoid Accountability? An Opinion
seoTitle: Press Conferences and Accountability: Why They Matter
seoDescription: Open press conferences test leaders with unscripted questions and follow-ups. How the US, UK, Germany and Japan do it, and India's record.
excerpt: A sourced comparison of how five democracies question their leaders, India's press-conference record from Nehru to 2026, the government's stated reasons, and seven counter-arguments weighed fairly.
